checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final image visibly warmer than first
Same mug, book, windowsill in same positions
must.why: Layout is identical pixel-for-pixel in appearance.
Geometry preserved; only colour and saturation changed, though the mug shifted from blue to teal.

faults.what: Warming is heavy and oversaturated; the background is blown out to yellow and shadows are crushed, looking like a strong filter.
The mug has drifted from blue toward teal/green, though the user wanted the blue mug kept.

summary: The warm version keeps the exact composition and is clearly warmer, but it is oversaturated and the blue mug looks teal.
